tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyag mchod rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi tshul bzung nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la gsol ba 'debs par 'dod pas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra dang ldan par byas te/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa byas la/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus// rin chen las grub gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa// pad+ma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i gdan steng du// thugs rjes rtsod pa'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams// rnam grol lam la 'god mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon// thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan chen po rnams// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// shes rab me 'bar nyon mongs mtsho skem zhing*// rnam grol bsod nams zhing du bka' sdod pa// phyogs bcu'i nyan thos dge 'dun bzhugs so 'tshal// yon sbyor mchod pa'i gnas su spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// 'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yis// sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag /gsung rab rin chen sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa// chos skyong dgra bcom chen po bzhugs so 'tshal// dam chos spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas// dus ldan rdo rje mo'i bu bzang po dang*// gser be'u bha ra bh+wa dza gser can dang*// 'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan zin// lam phran bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len// lam brtan klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang*// gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos tshul 'dzin cing*// khyad par can gyi phrin las chos skyong ba// gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir spyon gdan la bzhugs// bde gshegs bka' lung gtsor mdzad bstan pa srung*// rang don dor nas 'khor ba'i nags tshal du// gzhan don lhur mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug po// dam bcas thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// dge bsnyen skyabs gsol bden pa'i tshig nyan pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs 'bring mchis so 'tshal// bsod nams rin chen gling du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte ba la bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu/

phyag g.yas pa sa gnon/ g.yon pa mnyam gzhag rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ shar gyi pad 'dab bzhi la gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin phyag g.yas rin po che'i prog zhu bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po lam phran brtan/ phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len phyag g.yas na glegs bam/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po lam brtan phyag g.yas na glegs bam/ g.yon chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o// lho'i pad 'dab bzhi la gnas brtan klu'i sde phyag g.yas bum pa/ g.yon 'khar gsil bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po sbed byed phyag na glegs bam bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i dbus na spos phor bsnams pa/ mchan khung g.yon na rnga yab bsnams pa'o// nub kyi pad 'dab bzhi la/ gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub/ g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po dus ldan phyag na gser gyi rna kor bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa'o// byang gi pad 'dab bzhi la/ gnas brtan chen po bzang po phyag g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam par bzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po gser be'u phyag gnyis rin po che'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza gser can phyag gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po ba ku la phyag na ne'u le bsnams pa'o// sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharma tā phyag na rnga yab dang bum pa bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thod bcings pa/ sde snod kyi glegs bam mang po khur ba/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs pa/

dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ pus mo brdzes pa/ pus mo g.yas pa las stag gi tshogs sprul pa/ dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs shing mdun gyi nam mkha' la bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ de rnams kyi thugs dgongs gcig pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhabs la dus rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos skyong zhing lha mi kun gyi bsod nams kyi dpal zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bka' bsgos te/ mya ngan las mi 'das bar 'jig rten na mngon sum du bzhugs shing*/ bka' lung gi rjes su bsgrub pa/ 'phags pa'i tshig nges pas zhal gyis bzhes pa/ gangs ri chen po ti se la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung*/ 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang sum brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// 'di man 'gre'o// drang srong ri'i shel nags na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa 'khor dgra bcom pa brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// de'i nags kyi ngogs lo ma bdun pa zhes bya ba'i ri phug na/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// zangs gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po dus ldan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// siṅga la'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// chu bo ya mu nā'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bzang po 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// kha che'i yul na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po gser be'u 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// nub kyi ba lang spyod na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza gser can 'khor dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// byang gi sgra mi snyan na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ba ku la 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// pri yaṃ ku'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam phran brtan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong drug brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// shar gyi lus 'phags gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam brtan 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// ri'i rgyal po ngos yangs la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// ri'i rgyal po bhi hu lar 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sbed byed 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// gangs can ri'i rgyal po la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharma tā 'khor dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes mang du bzla'o// bstod pa bya/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul/ gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du bstan pa skyong mdzad pa// dkon mchog gsum dngos gnas brtan bcu drug gis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// thugs rje'i bdag nyid gnas brtan bcu drug gis// 'khor tshogs srid mtsho las brgal nyon mongs med// khri dang drug stong bzhi brgya'i tshogs rnams kyis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// sems can kun gyi gsos gyur dgra bcom pa// rig dang zhabs ldan skye dgu'i sbyin gnas che// 'phags pa'i gang zag chen po khyed rnams kyis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba gdab/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis ni// phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa 'phel gyur cing*// sdug bsngal kun 'byung ma lus rab spangs nas// srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skem par shog /bsod nams rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs gyur cing*// ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par dag gyur te// yon tan rgya mtsho ma lus kun rdzogs nas// 'jig rten kun las khyad par 'phags par shog /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yi// phrin las sgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med// skal ba mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje yis// nyan thos tshul du srid pa ji srid par// bstan pa skyong zhing 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos 'di jo bo rje lha gcig nyid kyi gdams pa yin/

jo bo bod du byon pa'i dus su phyag phyi ba paṇ+ḍi ta gsum byon pa'i nang nas sems tsam rnam rdzun gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i paṇ+ḍi gcig la rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis zhus/ de la dge bshes chen po po to bas zhus/ de la dge bshes chen po sha ra bas zhus/ de la dge bshes 'chad kha bas zhus/ de la dge bshes se skyil bas zhus/ de la dge bshes lha spyil bas

'od zer bla ma/ zhus/ de la dge bshes dre'u lhas tshul khrims 'od zer/ pas zhus/ de la bla ma rgan lhas pa ma ṇi hūm̐ 'bar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul khrims kyi rgyan dang ldan zhing snyan pa'i 'od zer 'bar bas phyogs bcur khyab pas zhus/ de la kho bos zhus/ bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams pa dge slong nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs pa'o// bla ma'i zhal nas 'di'i bsnyen pa'i tshad khri tsho gsum yin gsung*/ 'di'i sgrub thabs dang yer pa'i ras bris bcu bdun klu mes 'brom chung zhes pas rgya yul nas spyan drangs pa yin gsungs so// ༈ /thub pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi rjes gnang gi zin bris bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po gnas brtan bcu drug 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen dharma tā dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du/ maṇ+ḍal la sogs par tshon gyis dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ mtha' me ris bskor ba/ sna tshogs rdo rje mi dgos/ gzhan rta babs sogs dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun/ lha rnams phyogs mdog can gyi lte bar/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug bris pa'i dbus su/ zla gdan mtshon byed tshon dkar po/ de'i steng du mañdzi'i khar bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku rab gnas can bzhag 'dab ma bcu drug dang*/ sgo bzhir tshon spungs ljang gu re dang*/ dharma tā'i tshon spungs shar phyogs kyi pad+ma'i phyi rol du bkod/ mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog sogs dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par g.yas skor du bsham/ gtor ma zlum gtor gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas g.yon du bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ me tog gi nas dang*/ slob ma la dgos pa'i yo byad maṇ+ḍal mchod 'bru dang bcas pa bsham/ de nas bdag mdun thun mong du bsgrub pa ni/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was bdag dang dkyil 'khor sbyong ba sogs spyi dang mthun/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag dang mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ mum̐ las bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ na bza' ngur smrig gsum gsol ba/ shar gyi pad 'dab bzhi'i dang po la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i prog zhu bsnams pa/ gnyis pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan lam phran brtan phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gsum pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bha ra dh+wa dza phyag g.yas glegs bam/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bsnams pa/ bzhi pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan lam brtan g.yas glegs bam/ g.yon chos 'chad/ lho'i pad 'dab bzhi'i dang po la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan klu'i sde g.yas bum pa/ g.yon 'khar gsil 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan sbed byed phyag gnyis glegs bam 'dzin pa/ gsum pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan mi phyed pa phyag gnyis kyis byang chub mchod rten bsnams pa/ bzhi pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan yan lag 'byung phyag g.yas spos phor/ g.yon rnga yab 'dzin pa/ nub kyi pad 'dab bzhi'i dang po la/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan ma pham pa phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gnyis pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan nags na gnas g.yas sdigs mdzub/ g.yon rnga yab 'dzin pa/ gsum pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan dus ldan phyag gnyis kyis rna kor 'dzin pa/ bzhi pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan rdo rje mo'i bu phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub/

g.yon rnga yab/ byang gi pad 'dab bzhi'i dang po la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bzang po g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gnyis pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan gser be'u phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ gsum pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ bzhi pa la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan ba ku la phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ shar phyogs su dge bsnyen dharma tā g.yas rnga yab dang spos phor/ g.yon bum pa/ ral pa'i thod bcings/ rgyab tu sde snod kyi glegs bam khur ba/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs pa/ dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub tu bklubs pa/ pus mo brdzes pa/ pus mo g.yas pa nas stag gi tshogs spro ba/ shar sgor rgyal chen yul 'khor srung*/ lho sgor 'phags skyes po/ nub sgor spyan mi bzang*/ byang sgor rnam thos sras/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams bzhugs par gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de nas gnas brtan phyag mchod tshig lhug pa jo bos mdzad pa bklag tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa bzlas shing*/ gsol ba btab/ de nas gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ma hā mu ni sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs tshar lngas phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dril gsil bya zhing*/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/ thub pa chen po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs spyi 'gro/ gtor ma gnyis pa phyogs skyong la 'bul/

byin rlabs gong gis 'thus/ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ in+d+rā ya sogs cha gsum gtor ma'i phyogs skyong ltar gsum gyis phul la/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ phyogs skyong chen po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs spyi 'gro ste/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// slob ma'i bya ba ni/ slob ma du yod khrus byas/ gral la 'khod la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes gnang zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la 'khor gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gis bskor ba'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag mdun thun mong du bsgrubs te/ phyag mchod bsdus pa dang bcas pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba sogs legs par grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa tha mi dad pa la rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ thub pa mchog dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// 'gro ba'i mun sel mgon rnams kyi// tshogs la'ang bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'khor gnas brtan chen po bcu drug sogs la byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas/ sdig pa bshags pa sogs yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /bar brjod/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po dung dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i mum̐ las 'od 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i mum̐ la phog pas/ de las 'od 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs lus 'od kyi gong bu zhig tu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ zhes pa nas/ byang sgor rnams thos sras/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ byang sgor rnam thos sras rnams kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rnams kyis rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la sku'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ snyam pa'i gus 'dud dung dung pa byas pas slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas ston pa 'khor bcas kyi sku'i rnam pa dpag tu med par byon nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim pas/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing dril bu dkrol/ tad+ya thā'i sngags lan gsum/ de rnams kyis sku'i rjes gnang thob pas gnas skabs su lus kyi sgrib pa dag cing*/ mthar thug ston pa 'khor bcas kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka'i mum̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor nas yod pa las/ sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i zhal nas thon/

khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying khar mum̐ yig gi mthar dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ tad+ya thā sogs brjod/ de nas slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis me tog phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa slob ma mang nyung dang bstun la ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi don du/ khyed rang rnams dus da nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi don du ston pa gtso 'khor thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ rang rang gi ming nas brjod de/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bar dus da nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du ston pa gtso 'khor thams cad yi dam du bzung bar bgyi'o// slob dpon gyis me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing slob ma rnams la me tog gtor/ de rnams kyis gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob pas gnas skabs su ngag gi sgrib pa dag cing*/

mthar thug ston pa 'khor bcas kyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa la gus 'dud drag po dung dung pa byas pas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas byang chub chen po'i mchod rten/ rin po che'i prog zhu/ glegs bam/ rnga yab/ 'khar gsil la sogs pa phyag mtshan gi rnam pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas/ lha'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med par rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos par mdzod/ ces brjod cing dril bu dkrol/ tad+ya thā'i sngags lan gsum/ de rnams kyis thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pas gnas skabs su yid kyi sgrib pa dag cing mthar thug ston pa 'khor bcas kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas sogs dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs kyi sgo nas slob ma rnams so sor btang la/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos te/ byin rlabs bsdus pa spyi ltar byas nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shākya mu ni ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes/ sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dbus kyi thub pa'i sku la brtan bzhugs/ gzhan rnams la gshegs gsol/ bsngo ba bkra shis sogs bya'o// bstan pa'i gtso bo thub pa chen po 'khor gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dge bsnyen dharma tā dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni/

snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa sems dpa' chen po spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa dgu bzhes pa'i dus su thugs dgyes bzhin gnang ba ltar/ 'di'i yig cha ha cang gsal ba zhig mi 'dug pas/ gsung rgyun zin bris su dkar po zhes pa sa mo sbrul gyi lo nag pa zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nyin chos med snyom las mkhan dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis bris shing*/ spyan snga rin po che'i spyan lam phab ste zhus dag byas pa yin pas/ dag cing yid ches par yod pas bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
